source.name: Volkswagen maintenance schedule
source.note: Read from Volkswagen's 2021 USA maintenance schedule for its electric models, in Glovebox's wording. Check it against the maintenance booklet that came with your own car.
source.basis: The mileages and jobs of Volkswagen's own USA maintenance schedule for its electric models, as filed with NHTSA, for a car the owner maintains. Only those facts are taken; jobs are named in Glovebox's words and no text or layout is copied.
